veribench_fsc.note: Experiment 36 described CertJudge / VeriBench FSC R_v1 as about 343 items and about 5 experts. No file with that name is in this repository or in the trustworthy-theorem-judges tree fetched for this run. The scores below are the numeric final_score_0_5 cells in the experiment 09 CSV export, not a reconstructed 343-item table.

summary.name: summeval_expert
summary.notes: SummEval expert annotations on four aspects (coherence, consistency, fluency, relevance), native grades 1–5 stored as class values [1,2,3,4,5]. Every summary has [3] expert annotation records. The jsonl does not publish a stable rater id, so rater_id is the within-item vote index, not a person. Split group is the source article (filepath), so every system and aspect of one article stays in one split. Binary views use the pre-registered cut grade ≥ 4.

summary.name: summeval_crowd
summary.notes: SummEval crowd annotations on four aspects (coherence, consistency, fluency, relevance), native grades 1–5 stored as class values [1,2,3,4,5]. Every summary has [5] crowd annotation records. The jsonl does not publish a stable rater id, so rater_id is the within-item vote index, not a person. Split group is the source article (filepath), so every system and aspect of one article stays in one split. Binary views use the pre-registered cut grade ≥ 4.

summary.name: chaosnli_snli_mnli
summary.notes: Pooled ChaosNLI-SNLI and ChaosNLI-MNLI-matched. ChaosNLI SNLI or MNLI-matched, 3 classes, 100 votes per item in the author files. label_count order is entailment, neutral, contradiction. Ranked probability score uses that order as an imposed order (entailment < neutral < contradiction); it is not a native Likert scale. rater_id is a within-item vote index expanded from the counts, not a person. Each uid is its own split group. Item counts by file are kept distinct by the group prefix.

summary.name: chaosnli_alpha
summary.notes: ChaosNLI abductive NLI, native two-option labels. The release stores counts, not person ids; rater_id is the within-item vote index obtained by expanding label_count. Order is option 1 then option 2. Each item is its own split group.

summary.name: dices990
summary.notes: DICES-990 rater-level Q_overall. Yes means unsafe (DICES-990 README; DICES-350 uses the same question family). Order for ranked probability score: No < Unsure < Yes, values 0,1,2. Dropped 7217 rows whose rater_id is in the README quality-filter list (12 raters). rater_id is the released person id. Split group is item_id. Raters are crossed, so the same person can appear in train and test on different conversations; no conversation's raters are split.

summary.name: veribench_fsc_exp09
summary.notes: VeriBench FSC final_score_0_5 from trustworthy-theorem-judges experiment 09. Not the undescribed R_v1 343-item table.
